commit_subject: Editor: the arena miniature and the full arena screenshot are framed by all the NAV_ISLAND markers together, like the minimap - decorations far outside the playable area no longer shrink the arena. Maps without one keep the bounds of all the visible entities.

Avatars: the client sends its avatar again when it changes (the Steam or CrazyGames sign-in finishing after joining), and the host of a server from the game sends the account's avatar too, also when it arrives later (update_integrated_avatar). CrazyGames: disableChat also hides the chat of a server hosted in the browser, the leaderboards keep the account id's copy button (only the profile link is gone), the settings listener has its own try so a throw can't skip /user and the config, happytime isn't sent again on a restart of the tutorial's final level, the declarations excluded from CrazyGames builds are excluded too. Masterserver: notifications muted right after a launch no longer use up the per-address daily limit, an unknown (web) address gets only the hourly one, one lookup per address instead of a reference that could dangle.
fix: accept explicit `undefined` on optional option fields (#2278)

Corpse explosions push only characters running faster than 10 px/s - the drift left after stopping no longer gets a full push in an effectively random direction. With bots disabled (an all-zero quota, or no quota and none on the map) Progressive levels don't count at all, and /bots 0 reports 0/0 instead of PROGRESSIVE. An editor playtest of the quick test (no bots there) doesn't generate a navmesh even with Spawn bots. A test comment no longer calls 0.75 the balance zoom.

Enemy and teammate visibility, fixed and cut down: colors, darkening and teammate borders also without fog of war (told apart by the viewed character), colorized teammates no longer pulse with low health - only your own colorized border does - and the uncolorized low health pulse is 1 px again. Border widths clamped to the sliders' 1-4 (min/max_character_border_width_v), also after a Ctrl+click and from the config. The white lost-health highlight starts at the bar's value before the step, so it covers a whole shotgun volley. Friendly darkenings claim overlapping pixels before enemy ones. Shared: the shadow and darkening single-coverage pass, the HUD nickname, the shield absorption minimum (pe_absorption_info::get_hp_mult/get_cp_mult); the cinematic overrides live in the cinematic block; dead branches and a redundant format_enum removed, dependent settings indented.

Arena choosers: miniatures from an ad hoc atlas of their own (viewables_streaming::arena_miniatures), packed in the background like the project selector's and scaled down to 96 px (ad_hoc_atlas_input::max_image_side) - instead of a 1536x1536 grid decoded on the game thread and uploaded whole for every new arena. The miniatures changed on disk are packed again when a chooser opens. An empty tab shows (No arenas), the map cycle has the game mode under the arena frame, the rows reuse the arena name instead of four allocations each. The map catalogue and the project selector share their miniature column code (begin_miniature_columns, miniature_column_cell, end_miniature_row, list_miniature_size_v), a narrow catalogue window no longer wraps descriptions at a width below 1.
fix(dashboard): recover a malformed saved BQL history (w4/272)
chore(pm): close w4/272 — fixed in 00246057b
Support IJW native TLS static field access (#136183)
test(survey): drop the duplicated random/early-stop routing-key negative

--print-server-key only for a dedicated server: the Headless build or with --dedicated-server, otherwise an error (a server hosted from the game on Steam signs with the key of its Steam ID's folder, and the same binary is a Steam or a non-Steam one). It exits with an error when the key can't be read or its public key computed, the CHANGING CWD lines go to stderr so stdout has only the key on macOS too, get_keys_dir takes the user dir instead of reading USER_DIR. Test scripts pass --dedicated-server.

Entity creation without dangling memory: a clone copies its source's components and transform before allocating (the allocation could move the pool and the clone was copied from freed memory - e.g. a faction pad in the shooting range, a partial drop), a partial transfer makes room in its item's pool before taking any handle or reference into it (might_allocate_entities_of_type), a requested quantity below 1 other than -1 is rejected (a crafted drop of -100 added 100 rounds, 0 made empty stacks every step), creation_system fetches the new entity again after post_create. generate_equipment gives a chamber-fed gun its non_standard_charge when that one is set (it checked non_standard_mag). Shells can only be remnants, so spawning them while iterating guns never moves the gun pool. Stale friends of allocate_new_entity_access removed.
feat(mavlink): support 32-bit system IDs

Map catalogue: downloads that can't hang or mix up - a failed HTTP request ends the download with an error instead of keeping it running forever (every launch refused, --sync-external-arenas never done), a hash mismatch stops the map instead of requesting one more file that shifted every following map by one, miniatures are paired with their maps by the requested path and taken in request order, downloads go on with the window closed or collapsed, an empty or failed list no longer leaves Refresh and Provider disabled, a double click during a download no longer starts a download later. The downloader's stop flag is set under the queue lock (a missed wakeup hung join), disk write errors are caught, the web fetch callback no longer outlives its downloader, list_catalogue_error outlives the future writing it, the final rename is synced to IDBFS on web, byte counters are reset only by the worker, the unused miniature mutex is gone.
feat(msg): widen system IDs to 32 bit

Audit reports: findings numbered once across the whole report - the Top tab shows each finding's own number instead of starting at 1 again, so a number names exactly one finding (NUM_BASE in both report templates, a rule in audit-gameplay and audit-green-red).
